title: Revise stories without losing identity or provenance

steps.action: Create two concurrent complete revisions from one story revision.
steps.expected_result: Both heads remain visible and no current revision is fabricated.

steps.action: Append one revision that names both concurrent heads.
steps.expected_result: The reconciled revision becomes current and every earlier revision remains available.

steps.action: Reword an existing obligation while retaining its criterion ID and attempt to reuse an actually removed ID.
steps.expected_result: The reworded obligation keeps its identity and reuse of the removed identity is rejected.

steps.action: Attach an immutable citation and replay or try to rewrite it.
steps.expected_result: The citation remains the requirement source, identical replay is a no-op, and rewriting is rejected.

expected_result: Story revisions, competing heads, criterion identity, and citations remain explicit, immutable, and reconcilable.
